edge_guide_autopush_desc: Want Sanctuary OS to push your updated manifest.json or catalog.json directly from the Sandbox without opening a browser? Select an Auto-Push Provider in Rules & Upload! Your scoped token stays 100% local on your PC, and clicking Export & Auto-Push (.zip) automatically rolls old hashes into previous_hashes, updates your live manifest.json or merges into catalog.json, stamps the live URL into your release .zip, and triggers update pings for all {Citizens}.
edge_guide_autopush_title: 1-Click OS Auto-Push (GitHub, Gist, Cloudflare, Neocities & Custom Host)
edge_guide_hero_sub: Make any Tier 1–4 or independent {mod} behave like a synced {mod}—with automatic update alerts, DLC/dependency/conflict rules, multi-file family grouping, and in-place upgrades at $0 hosting cost.
edge_guide_host_catalog_desc: Instead of managing separate manifest.json URLs for 20+ {mods}, you can point all of your {mods} to a single https://.../catalog.json URL containing an 'artifacts' array. Sanctuary OS automatically matches each installed {mod} inside catalog.json by artifact_id, name, current_hashes, or previous_hashes.
edge_guide_host_catalog_title: Option C: One Master catalog.json for Your Entire Catalog
edge_guide_host_cf_desc: Connect your GitHub repository to Cloudflare Pages (or upload manifest.json to your existing web host). Every git push automatically deploys your updated manifest.json globally with zero bandwidth fees.
edge_guide_host_cf_title: Option B: Cloudflare Pages / Personal Domain (Free, Unlimited Bandwidth)
edge_guide_host_github_desc: 1. Create a free public GitHub repository (e.g., my-sims-manifests). 2. Upload your exported manifest.json (or a single catalog.json for all your {mods}). 3. Click the file on GitHub and click 'Raw' to copy the raw.githubusercontent.com URL. 4. Paste that URL into Static Polling Manifest URL before exporting your release .zip.
edge_guide_lineage_how_desc: Sanctuary OS identifies {mods} by cryptographic SHA-256 DNA rather than fragile filenames. Every exported manifest.json tracks three hash layers so updates and multi-file suites never break:
edge_guide_lineage_how_title: How Lineage Hash Tracking Works Under the Hood
edge_guide_lineage_layer1_desc: Records the primary .package hash plus every sibling .package and .ts4script module in the current release. All sibling modules in a multi-file suite (like MCCC) are recognized as current and grouped under a single parent folder card.
edge_guide_lineage_layer2_desc: Every time you click Export Static Manifest (.zip) over an existing Sandbox folder (or add historical hashes in Details & Versions), prior release hashes are rolled into previous_hashes. When Sanctuary OS polls your remote manifest.json, any {Citizen} whose installed file matches a hash in previous_hashes immediately receives an Update Available badge.
edge_guide_lineage_layer3_desc: When a {Citizen} drops your new v1.1.0 .zip into Sanctuary OS, the ingestion engine checks their installed {Vault} against previous_hashes. Even if you renamed MyMod_v1.0.package to MyMod_v1.1.package, Sanctuary OS finds the old v1.0 file by its lineage hash and replaces it in-place inside the exact same subfolder—preventing duplicate {mod} collisions.
edge_guide_lineage_rules_desc: In Rules & Upload, dependencies and conflicts can reference other {mods} by SHA-256 hash, Registry UUID, or plain {mod} name (e.g., 'XML Injector'). Sanctuary OS resolves both object rules and plain string names automatically.
edge_guide_lineage_rules_title: Flexible Dependency & Conflict Matching (Hash or Name)
edge_guide_step1_desc: Drop your .package, .ts4script, and optional .cfg/.ini files into Dev/Sandbox (or click Import in the {Mason} Workshop). Open the {mod} card and configure its Details & Versions (Name, {Mason} Version, Safety Tier 0–4, Game Versions), Files & Folders (Twin scripts, Add-on modules, Folder Structure), and Rules & Upload (Required DLC, Dependencies, and Severity 3–4 Conflicts).
edge_guide_step2_desc: Paste the raw URL where your manifest.json (single {mod}) or catalog.json (all your {mods} in one file) will live—such as GitHub Raw, Cloudflare Pages, GitLab Raw, or your own website. Sanctuary OS embeds this URL directly into both manifest.json and override.json inside your release .zip.
edge_guide_step3_desc: Click Export Static Manifest (.zip) in Rules & Upload (or the top-right inbox icon). Sanctuary OS computes the SHA-256 hash of every file in your release, writes manifest.json and override.json into your Sandbox folder, and bundles {ModName}_v{Version}_SanctuaryRelease.zip. Upload the .zip to your download page (Patreon, Itch.io, CurseForge, SFS) and push manifest.json to your static URL.
edge_guide_step4_desc: When releasing v1.1.0+, place the updated .package/.ts4script files into the same Sandbox folder, bump the {Mason} Version field, and click Export Static Manifest (.zip) again. Sanctuary OS automatically reads your previous manifest.json and SQLite history, rolls the old v1.0.0 SHA-256 hashes into previous_hashes (archive_hashes), and records the new hashes as current_hashes. Replace manifest.json on your static host—every {Citizen} on v1.0.0 will automatically get an Update Available alert!
edge_guide_step5_desc: A {Citizen} drags your release .zip into Sanctuary OS once. With zero confirmation popups, Sanctuary OS registers your manifest_url and lineage hashes in SQLite, marks the {mod} STABLE, groups multi-file suites into a single parent card, enforces your DLC/Dependency/Conflict rules, alerts them when you update manifest.json, and replaces old files in-place (even if renamed) when they drop the new .zip.

lexicon_guide_hero_desc: Sanctuary OS routes every label, button, tooltip, and icon through the {Lexicon} Engine. By editing the 21 Core {Glossary} Terms or customizing module strings, you can transform the entire OS into any theme or language in seconds.
lexicon_guide_parity_alert_desc: The floating alert pill at the bottom tracks your translation coverage against en-default.json. Use Next Empty to jump directly to the next untranslated field, + Add Missing to populate missing baseline keys, or Purge Keys to strip deprecated keys.

lexicon_guide_t1_desc: In Tab 1 (Core Terms), editing a single noun like {Mod} (e.g. "Mod" → "Artifact" or "CC / Mod") automatically interpolates across every sentence in Sanctuary OS at runtime — no need to manually edit hundreds of individual lines.
lexicon_guide_t1_title: 1. Change 21 Core Terms to Re-Theme 1,700+ Strings
lexicon_guide_t2_desc: The {Lexicon} Engine automatically respects token casing: {Mod} renders Title Case ("Artifact"), {mod} renders lowercase ("artifact"), and {MOD} renders UPPERCASE ("ARTIFACT"). It even fixes English articles automatically ("a {mod}" → "an Artifact").
lexicon_guide_t3_desc: Whenever a string contains a {Glossary} token such as {Vault} or {Blueprint}, the Visual Studio displays a live cyan preview badge (→ ...) underneath the input field showing how the final sentence will read with your current Core Terms.
lexicon_guide_t3_title: 3. Live Interpolation Preview in OS Modules
lexicon_guide_t4_desc: Every icon in the OS resolves through icon_<glyph>. You can remap any icon in Tab 4 (Pack & Tools) by adding an icon_* override (for example, mapping icon_delete to delete_forever or auto_delete) without touching source code.
lexicon_guide_tab1_card_desc: Controls the 21 global domain nouns ({Mod}, {Vault}, {Blueprint}, {Mason}, {Citizen}, {Backups}, {Lab}, {Settings}, {Nexus}, {Chameleon}, {Lexicon}, {Dispatch}, {Delete}, {Remove}). Includes a 1-click "Apply Terms From {Lexicon}..." preset bar.

schema_guide_backups_airgap_desc: Folders listed in Save Airgap Targets are automatically snapshotted before a {Lab} sandbox test begins and restored the moment verification finishes, guaranteeing zero save corruption during {Mod} testing.
schema_guide_backups_targets_desc: World State targets back up player saves and creations (e.g. saves, Tray, Profiles) relative to user_data_dir. Engine State targets back up core game binaries or root folders (e.g. Game, Data) relative to live_path.

schema_guide_ext_config_desc: Extensions listed here (.cfg, .ini, .json, .toml, .yaml) are monitored by the Dynamic Config Watcher. When a {Mod} generates or updates a settings file in the live game folder, Sanctuary OS syncs it back into the {Mod}'s {Vault} folder and deduplicates root stray copies.
schema_guide_ext_supported_desc: Supported Extensions (.package, .ts4script, .archive, .esp, .pak, .rpf) are deployed during ignition. {Vault} Visible Extensions also include archives (.zip, .rar, .7z) so you can inspect or unpack them in your {Vault}.
schema_guide_hero_desc: A Master Schema JSON tells Sanctuary OS how to detect, deploy, load-order, airgap, and diagnose any game engine on Windows and macOS — from The Sims 4 and Cyberpunk 2077 to GTA V, Skyrim SE, Baldur's Gate 3, and Stardew Valley.
schema_guide_lo_desc: Choose Folder Priority (alphabetical tier folders like ZZ_Overrides), Numeric Prefix ({index:03}_ prepended to links), Manifest List (generates Resource.cfg, plugins.txt, or modsettings.lsx), or Modified Timestamp Order.
schema_guide_logs_matcher_desc: Use Prefix + Extension (e.g. Starts With: lastexception, Ends With: .txt) to catch timestamped crash logs, or switch the Rule Type dropdown to Exact Filename (e.g. ScriptHookV.log, red4ext.log) for fixed log files.
schema_guide_logs_matcher_title: Prefix + Extension vs. Exact Filename Matchers
schema_guide_logs_rules_desc: Each rule scans matched logs for Pipe-Separated Keywords (e.g. AttributeError | ImportError), assigns a Threat Level (Critical, Warning, Info), and surfaces a human-readable Diagnostic Analysis and Countermeasure Protocol.
schema_guide_path_var_mac: macOS User Home Directory, Documents, and Application Support roots.
schema_guide_path_var_sub: Relative path from the game root to the executable folder (e.g. Game/Bin or bin/x64). Leave blank if the binary sits in the root folder.
schema_guide_path_var_win: Windows User Profile, AppData Local, and AppData Roaming roots.
schema_guide_paths_desc: Sanctuary OS automatically expands Windows and macOS environment tokens at runtime and resolves macOS .app bundles cleanly:
schema_guide_routes_desc: Route specific extensions outside the standard {Mods} folder — either relative to the live game install (live_path, e.g. Data/Shared/Worlds/Areas for .world files or bin/x64/plugins for .dll plugins) or relative to the user data root (user_data_dir).
schema_guide_s1_desc: Choose from 7 pre-configured game architectures (DBPF + Python, REDengine 4, Creation Engine, RAGE / OpenIV, Larian .pak, SMAPI, or Universal) and click Apply Preset, or click Populate Safe Defaults to fill any missing keys without overwriting your existing values.

schema_guide_s2_desc: Define the game's Windows (.exe) and macOS (.app) binaries, Binary Subfolder (e.g. Game/Bin or bin/x64), {Mods} folder, Telemetry/Saves root, and Vanilla Isolation safeguards.
schema_guide_s3_desc: Specify which file extensions are supported, which config files (.ini, .cfg, .json, .toml, .yaml) are tracked by the Dynamic Config Watcher, where special extensions (.world, .asi, .dll) route on disk, and how Load Order is enforced.

schema_guide_s4_desc: The floating Schema Validation Alert compares your file against the Keepers Core Default Schema in real time. Click + Add Missing to inject any missing baseline keys, then Save locally or Sync to Spoke.
schema_guide_safe_preserve_desc: Keep internal folder hierarchies intact when importing multi-folder archives (required for Cyberpunk 2077 archive/pc/mod, Skyrim Data/, and Stardew Valley SMAPI {Mods}).

schema_doc_scan_paths_desc: Default Steam, EA App, Origin, Epic, GOG, and macOS /Applications paths checked automatically during workspace setup.
schema_doc_depth_desc: Maximum subfolder recursion depth the engine can read for script archives (e.g. 1 folder deep for .ts4script) vs. regular packages (5 folders deep).
schema_doc_ver_file_desc: Relative path to the file storing the installed game patch string and the regex pattern used to extract it, with Windows Registry and macOS Plist fallbacks.
schema_doc_dlc_desc: Subfolders and folder regex used to detect installed DLC packs on Windows/macOS, plus the command-line template for disabling packs during {Lab} testing.
schema_doc_ext_supported_desc: All deployable {Mod} extensions that Sanctuary OS links into the live game folders during ignition.
schema_doc_ext_vault_desc: All file extensions shown inside the {Vault} browser, including supported {Mod} files plus .zip, .rar, and .7z archives.
schema_doc_ext_primary_desc: Binary package formats indexed by the Conflict Radar for resource and tuning collisions.
schema_doc_ext_script_desc: Executable or script formats governed by Script Max Depth and deep heuristic malware scanning.
schema_doc_ext_ignore_desc: Harmless companion or documentation files ignored by the Unidentified File scanner.
schema_doc_cache_files_desc: Engine cache files automatically purged when switching {Blueprints} or {Mods} so stale data never persists.
schema_doc_parsers_desc: Maps file extensions to native Rust binary parsers (dbpf, ts4script, rage_rpf) and UI card badge labels (PACKAGE, SCRIPT, CONFIG).
schema_doc_route_id_desc: Unique identifier and display label for a custom deployment rule that routes specific file types outside the main {Mods} folder.
schema_doc_route_target_desc: Selects the base root (game_dir / live_path, user_data_dir, or mod_dir) and the exact subfolder where matching files deploy.
schema_doc_route_exts_desc: File extensions routed by this rule (.world, .asi, .dll) and the maximum subfolder recursion allowed at the destination (0 = flat).
schema_doc_route_flags_desc: Flatten strips nested archive folders on deploy; Shared With Vanilla tracks links in .sanctuary_deployed_links.json so vanilla files in that destination folder are never deleted.
schema_doc_lo_templates_desc: Formatting patterns used when Strategy is set to Numeric Prefix ({index:03}_) or Manifest List (*{filename}).
schema_doc_manifest_header_desc: Complete Resource.cfg or manifest file content written when compiling Folder Priority override tiers.
schema_doc_tiers_desc: Defines the load order tiers available to {Citizens}. Higher Priority Weight tiers win resource conflicts over lower tiers.
schema_doc_lab_ram_desc: Seconds the game must run steadily before {Lab} marks boot stable, plus Min RAM Step (%) and Warm Cache RAM Step (%) thresholds.
schema_doc_lab_saves_desc: Save file extensions monitored during {Lab} verification runs.
schema_doc_exc_meta_desc: Unique rule ID, target log filename hint, and severity badge (Critical, Warning, or Info) displayed when a log matches.
schema_doc_tc_world_desc: User data folders and settings files (relative to user_data_dir) archived during World State {Backups} snapshots.
schema_doc_tc_engine_desc: Core game binary folders (relative to the game installation root) archived during Engine State {Backups} snapshots.

landing_partners_about_drawer_sub: 100% Data Sovereignty • Turnkey Setup • Bilateral Uplink • Governance
landing_partners_what_h1: 1. Sovereign Game Workspace — Never a Central Silo
landing_partners_what_p1: A Sanctuary OS Partner Spoke is an independent, community-governed game workspace (e.g. Skyrim, GTA V, Stardew Valley, Baldur's Gate 3). Unlike legacy modding portals, your community owns its own Supabase PostgreSQL database, Master Schema, {Mod} registry, and Chameleon themes. Either side can sever the uplink ('Cut the Cord') at any time with zero data loss.
landing_partners_what_h2: 2. Zero Platform Tax (0% Cut) & Mutual Supporter Perks
landing_partners_what_p2: Sanctuary Foundry takes 0% of {Mason} or Partner Community revenue. Partner Spokes link their own non-custodial Stripe, Ko-fi, or Patreon checkout directly in Wayfinder Operations, and every $5 a {Citizen} contributes to a verified Partner Spoke automatically grants them +30 days of Global Daily Dev Build access across Sanctuary OS.
landing_partners_setup_h1: 1. Provision Your Supabase Instance & Run schema.sql
landing_partners_setup_p1: Create a dedicated Supabase project owned by your community team. Open the SQL Editor and execute Sanctuary OS's 36-table schema.sql bootstrap script to initialize profiles, {mods}, {mod}_versions, {masons}, {blueprints}, audit_logs, and row-level security (RLS) policies.
landing_partners_setup_p2: Define your game's supported {Mod} file extensions (.package, .ts4script, .pak, .esp, .rpf, .asi), installation target folders, load-order rules, and conflict radar heuristics inside your Master Schema JSON.
landing_partners_connect_p1: Once your Partner Spoke application is approved by Keepers Core, open Wayfinder Operations -> Spoke Control -> Spoke Setup & Maintenance to generate your SANCTUARY-UPLINK:// bundle containing your Project URL, Anon Key, and Service Role Key.
landing_partners_connect_p2: Keepers Core runs a live schema and RLS handshake check against your Spoke. Once verified, your workspace goes live on the Sanctuary OS Hub switcher for Desktop, Web, and Mobile PWA {Citizens}.
landing_partners_maintain_p1: Manage your workspace day-to-day from Wayfinder Operations: appoint Architects and Oversight moderators, verify {Masons}, triage community reports, review heuristic malware flags, and rotate your Supabase keys anytime with zero downtime.
landing_partners_maintain_p2: Every administrative action is recorded in your Spoke's immutable audit_logs table. If your community ever wishes to operate standalone, click 'Cut the Cord' in Spoke Control to sever the Hub uplink immediately while keeping 100% of your database.

landing_partners_what_p4: Connecting a Partner Spoke mounts your game workspace across the Sanctuary OS Desktop Client (Windows & macOS), Web Portal, and Mobile PWA with conflict detection, {Backups}, and {Blueprints}.

landing_partners_connect_p4: Once linked, your Spoke automatically receives global heuristic malware definitions while keeping all community {Mod} records, {Citizens}, and dispatches hosted strictly on your own Supabase instance.
landing_partners_maintain_p3: Link your community's Stripe, Ko-fi, or Patreon checkout URL in Wayfinder Operations. 100% of funds go directly to your processor (0% platform cut) while automatically crediting {Citizens} +30 days of Dev Builds per $5.

flag_res_mod_why_unstable: This {Mod} was marked Unstable after compatibility warnings or minor gameplay glitches were reported.
flag_res_mod_why_review: This {Mod} is currently Under Review by Sanctuary moderation or automated compatibility checks.
flag_res_mod_why_tickets: This {Mod} has open {Citizen} bug or compatibility reports awaiting {Mason} review.
flag_res_mod_corrupted_detail: The current release hash is flagged as Corrupted. {Citizens} with this {Mod} installed receive a critical alert in their {Vault} until a patched version hash is published and status is restored to Stable.
flag_res_mod_unstable_detail: The current release is marked Unstable. {Citizens} see a caution badge in their {Vault}. Verify compatibility with the latest game patch or attach a hotfix version below.
flag_res_mod_review_detail: This {Mod} is awaiting verification of its metadata, safety tier, or release hash. Review the fields below and resubmit to restore Stable status.
flag_res_mod_step_1: Review the diagnostic or {Citizen} bug report(s) above and test your updated {Mod} files in your {Lab}.
flag_res_mod_step_2: Bump the {Mason} Version, verify compatible Game Versions, and link your patched file hash under Version History below.
flag_res_mod_step_3: Click Resolve & Resubmit {Mod} below to close open tickets, set status back to Stable, and publish your fix.
lo_tier_standard_desc: Loads in the standard queue before priority overrides
lo_tier_final_desc: Loads last and wins all tuning & visual overlaps
lo_tier_1_desc: Loads after standard {mods} to win basic overrides
lo_queue_hint: Later {Mods} override earlier {Mods} when they modify the same game resource.
lo_move_first: Move to Start of Tier (Loads Earliest)
lo_move_last: Move to End of Tier (Loads Latest / Wins)
lo_detected_overlaps_desc: This {mod} shares internal game resources with {count} other {mods}. Make it load after a rival to win the override, or inspect and resolve the conflict.
lo_tier_1_agnostic_desc: Loads after standard {mods} to win basic overrides
lo_tier_3_agnostic_desc: Loads last and wins all tuning & visual overlaps
radar_s3_desc: Both {mods} modify the same tuning or data resources. Whichever {mod} loads later (higher # in Load Order) wins and controls gameplay.
radar_s1_desc: Both {mods} replace the same texture, mesh, or string table. Safe to keep both — pick which {mod} loads last to control the visual look.
radar_step1_winner_desc: Select the {mod} whose changes should take priority in-game. Sanctuary will promote it so it loads after the rival {mod}.
radar_step1_keep_desc: Only one of these {mods} should remain active. Select the {mod} you want to keep; the other will be safely moved out of your active {blueprint}.
lo_winner_tier_target: Winner Priority Tier (Loads After Earlier Tiers)
lo_role_tier3_desc: Loads last • Wins all resource overlaps
radar_click_resource_diff_hint: Click any overlapping resource below to open the side-by-side Diff Inspector and compare exact values between {Mod} A and {Mod} B.
radar_binary_diff_notice: Binary / Compiled Resource Telemetry Comparison (Hex & Header Summary)
flag_res_bp_audit_summary: Automated Tier 0 Compliance Audit — Only verified Tier 0 {mods} with Stable status are permitted in {Nexus} {Blueprints}.
flag_res_bp_step_1: Click any flagged {mod} below to open its Dossier and inspect its current verification status or safety tier.
flag_res_bp_step_2: Verify those {mods} in your {Vault} / {Lab}, or let Sanctuary automatically strip non-compliant {mods} from this {Blueprint}.
flag_res_bp_step_3: Click Remove Non-Compliant & Re-Upload below to publish the sanitized {Blueprint} and clear the {Nexus} flag.
flag_res_inspect_dossier_hint: Click any {mod} to open its Dossier
lo_reorder_tier_desc: Drag cards or use the controls below to reorder {mods} within this priority tier. Later {mods} (#02, #03...) load last and win resource overlaps.
dir_toast_published_live: Published live to {Citizens} and synced with local .md file!
